source_text: Tintinnabula et mala granata in ora vestis — sonus doctrinae et fructus operum. Ingrediens sancta audiatur.
pass_a_gloss: Bells and pomegranates on hem of-garment — sound of-teaching and fruit of-works. Entering holy-places let-him-be-heard.
pass_b_english: [[Bells and pomegranates on the hem >> Bible:Exodus 28:33-35]] — teaching’s sound and works’ fruit. Entering the holy place, let him be heard.
